caseStudies.title: Anirudh.website

pipeline.description: Engineering an interactive portfolio system blending editorial typography and a real-time WebGL city model:

steps.title: 3D Optimization
steps.desc: Decimating, Draco-compressing, and texturing a 1.5GB GLB model down to a web-ready 41.6MB.

steps.title: Data Extraction
steps.desc: Building custom scripts to extract EXIF data from photos and normalize the career ledger.

steps.title: Component Design
steps.desc: Integrating IBM Carbon and Plex Design Tokens dynamically into a no-bundler native ES modules layout.

steps.title: Repository Infrastructure
steps.desc: Comprehensive engineering spanning the 3D scene engine, responsive camera rig, gallery system, and automated visual testing.

evidence.caption: Dynamic WebGL 3D City archive view
Roles navigation directory indexing freelance and production hats
Clients folder directory indexing studio and client engagements
Interactive 3D Creative Portfolio Semantic Graph for visual career mapping

milestones.title: Repository Initialized
milestones.desc: First commit, scaffolded vanilla JS + Three.js + GSAP architecture with import maps, no bundler.

milestones.title: Interactive City Release
milestones.desc: Released the physical city-map interface with customized building hovers and roles filters.

milestones.title: Design System Architecture
milestones.desc: Migrated interactive UI to IBM Carbon and Plex token architecture with semantic custom properties.

milestones.title: Quality Infrastructure Shipped
milestones.desc: Automated regression tests, strict linting, and CI pipeline.

outcomes.retrospective:
Building this portfolio was an exercise in technical optimization. Combining complex Three.js render passes, GSAP camera movements, and Carbon design tokens without using a heavyweight bundler resulted in a fast-loading, immersive website.

The deliberate architectural choice: vanilla ES modules over framework bloat, native web standards over npm fragility, and bespoke performance tuning over generic abstractions.
outcomes.status: Active personal website and live portfolio, serving as a primary sandbox for creative tech experiments.

caseStudies.summary: An interactive archive of my work from 2010 to 2026: a WebGL city of 74 entries, built solo with vanilla ES modules, Three.js and IBM Carbon design tokens.
